title: Disclosed open items in both systems.
caption: Items each project documents about itself. oz-policy-builder rates its items in a STRIDE register; Perch keeps none, so its rows give the status its documents state. H-1/E-36 and E-38 arise from features Perch lacks; their absence in Perch is not a security property of Perch.
rows: The completion marker is consumed by the target's canonical identity, not its exact bytes
Delegated signers do not bind rule IDs
Replacing a capped rule, or changing its cap, starts an empty window
A rule edited in place between signing and inclusion decides under its new contents
Grant installs take no expected version
One key is admin and manager of `perch/verifiers` on testnet and mainnet; the admin can replace the registry's code at once
H-1/E-36: a keyed door on a no-gate adapter without the grants pin
E-38: a keyless follower's fence can be loosened by the followed rule's admins
T-19: the review reaches the owner through the agent
